## What was created

`tests/org/apache/commons/csv/CSVPrinterAgentTest.java` — a self-contained JUnit 3.8 (`junit.framework.TestCase`) suite in the class's own package. No external test helpers; two private nested fixtures:

- **`RecordingWriter`** (`extends java.io.Writer`) — captures output and counts `flush()`/`close()` calls, to observe delegation.
- **`FakeResultSet`** — a `java.sql.ResultSet` built via `java.lang.reflect.Proxy`, handling only `getMetaData`/`getColumnCount`/`next`/`getObject`/`getString`, everything else returning typed defaults.

## Coverage (all assertions traced to `api/.../CSVPrinter.html`)

| Area | Cases |
|---|---|
| Constructor | `null` out → `IllegalArgumentException`; `null` format → `IllegalArgumentException`; no output emitted before first print |
| `getOut()` | returns the exact `Appendable`/`Writer` passed in ("the target Appendable"); reflects written state |
| `print(Object)` | verbatim single value; delimiter inserted only between values; never emits a record separator; encapsulates on embedded delimiter / CR-LF; doubles embedded quote; plain value left unquoted; custom delimiter via `withDelimiter(';')` incl. comma-no-longer-special |
| `println()` | emits exactly `\r\n`; resets to a fresh record (no leading delimiter after); repeatable |
| `printRecord(Object...)` / `(Iterable)` | happy path; quoting where needed; interior empty fields kept (`a,,b`); empty args → just `\r\n`; consecutive records; RFC4180 format |
| `printRecords(Object[])` / `(Iterable)` | flat collection → one record per element; array-of-arrays; array-of-iterables; empty → no output; iterable-of-iterables |
| `printRecords(ResultSet)` | rows printed as records; values quoted; empty result set → no output |
| `flush()` | delegates to underlying `Flushable`; no-op / output intact on a plain `StringBuilder` |
| `close()` | delegates to underlying `Closeable`; harmless + idempotent on non-`Closeable` target |
| `printComment(String)` | documented no-op when comments disabled (`CSVFormat.DEFAULT`) — alone, between records, and with empty string |

Fixtures deliberately lean only on `CSVFormat.DEFAULT`, `CSVFormat.RFC4180`, and `withDelimiter(char)` (stable across all Commons CSV releases), since `api/` documents only `CSVPrinter`. Per your restrictions, tests were compiled but not run, and nothing in `lib/` was decompiled.
